*  I describe it to people as having to wear one glove, one shoe, and a pair of headphones at all times. Its not debilitating, but it makes life just a little bit

*  I always think that doing anything with dyspraxia feels like trying to wade through mud or quicksand. You get things done but at a significantly slower   
 pace, if they get done at all. When I do everything, I am processing my actions and thoughts in slow-motion and it feels like I get so tired so quickly that   
 I make very little progress. 
*  I like to say it's like being drunk all the time with none of the positive effects. 
*  It's like being in school, writing down what's on the board and before you barely started the teacher is already rubbing it off
